_comment: Direct GGUF inference config. Bypasses Ollama. Uses llama-cpp-python.
_blob_root_note: Resolved at runtime from LLMS_DIR env var or config/paths.py. Do not hardcode.

flash_moe_strategy._desc: Expert tensor offloading: attention layers on GPU, FFN experts in CPU RAM
flash_moe_strategy._why: 12 attn layers fit in 2GB VRAM; 31 expert FFN layers stay mmap'd in RAM

mlx_no_swap._mmap_why: GGUF memory-mapped: only accessed (active expert) pages load into RAM
mlx_no_swap._mlock_why: Pinned pages cannot be evicted to swap; 16GB free RAM > 9.1GB model

deepseek-r1-1.5b._gpu_note: Partial GPU: ~1GB near VRAM limit; remainder mmap'd

cpu_control._affinity_why: Core 0 reserved for OS; prevents system hang

notes: Flash-MoE: MoE models only activate a subset of experts per token.
With use_mmap=True, inactive expert weights are NOT loaded into RAM — only accessed pages are.
This achieves sparse expert loading comparable to Flash-MoE without custom kernels.
use_mlock=True prevents active pages from being swapped — essential on 34GB RAM + 9GB model.
Q4_K_M is already 4-bit. Further requantization (Q3_K_S/Q2_K) possible with llama-quantize.
MLX concept applied: lazy load (mmap) + unified address space (no GPU copy overhead for experts).
